name: Writhing Haunt
summary: East of the Ruins of Andorhal, plague vapors drift from the Writhing Haunt across the Western Plaguelands. The Scourge seized this farmstead, once fertile land that fed Lordaeron, and turned it into a source of disease.

sections.title: A Field of Disease
sections.body: During the Third War, the Writhing Haunt fell swiftly, like many human homesteads around Andorhal. Its fields now yield rot instead of crops. The Scourge planted an enormous plague cauldron in the tilled earth, where it continually vents diseased vapors. Rotting ghouls, freezing ghouls, and fetid zombies wander the overgrown furrows. Cauldron Lord Razarch commands them and guards the machinery.

sections.title: A Watcher in the Ruins
sections.body: The cauldron's choking miasma has not driven everyone away. Mulgris Deepriver, a tauren druid, lingers inside one of the dilapidated farmhouses. He came to heal nature's wounds, but the plague has stricken him too. Unable to cure the suffering beasts, he asks capable travelers to grant the diseased wolves and other wildlife a swift, merciful release.

faq.q: What was the Writhing Haunt before the plague?
faq.answer: Before the Third War, the Writhing Haunt was a productive human farm. It sustained the land and supplied grain and livestock to nearby Andorhal and the greater Kingdom of Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why is there a giant cauldron in the middle of the field?
faq.answer: The Scourge placed the giant cauldron in the field to brew and spread plague vapors across the countryside. The vapors poison soil, water, and nearby living creatures.

aliases: who is in charge writhing haunt
faq.answer: Cauldron Lord Razarch, an undead servant of the Scourge, commands the site. Ghouls and zombies guard the plague cauldron for him.

faq.q: Who is hiding in the farmhouse?
faq.answer: Mulgris Deepriver, a tauren druid, shelters inside an abandoned farmhouse. He came to the Plaguelands to heal nature, but the plague cannot be cured, so he asks travelers to end the suffering of diseased wildlife.

angles.text: Plague vapors desecrate the Writhing Haunt's rich farmland and offend the natural order. The cauldron must be silenced.
The farmland outside Andorhal lies under Scourge rule, reduced to a diseased wasteland. It is a bitter reminder of Lordaeron's fall.
